summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing for FASE 37 (Kalibrasi Sekali Klik). All 13 user stories passed successfully: calibration dialog workflow, RBAC (PM/Site/Sales), different calibration types (duration/wait_time/wait_into_plan), history & rollback, and new /build-calibration page. Regression tests confirm old pages (/construction, /build-calendar, /) still work without errors.
passed_tests: USER STORY 1: PM login → /construction → Analytics tab shows delay analytics panel with summary cards and calibration recommendations
USER STORY 2: Calibration dialog opens in-place from recommendation button, pre-filled with calibration kind and delta, auto-preview loads
USER STORY 3: Apply button correctly disabled until reason selected and note >=10 chars, hint message guides user
USER STORY 4: Preview shows explanation text and before→after rows for affected steps with 'dikalibrasi' markers
USER STORY 5: Impact panel clearly states existing schedules NOT changed, only future schedules use new values
USER STORY 6: After filling reason and note, calibration applies successfully, result message shown, applied marker appears
USER STORY 7: History panel displays calibration rows with timestamp, user, reason, and rollback buttons
USER STORY 8: Rollback dialog requires note >=10 chars, after confirmation shows 'reverted' marker and removes 'applied' marker
USER STORY 9: Calibration from step table works in both /construction analytics and /build-calibration page, dialog opens with correct step

USER STORY 10: /build-calibration page loads with all required elements: 5 summary cards, safety note, scope selector (Semua proyek/Per proyek), recommendation panel, step table, template panel with selector and 20+ step rows, history panel
USER STORY 11: Site role can view /build-calibration page but all calibrate buttons disabled, viewer note explains view-only access
USER STORY 12: Sales role gets polite access denied message (403) with clear explanation, not raw error
USER STORY 13: Different calibration types work: can switch between step_duration, wait_time, and wait_into_plan with appropriate explanations
REGRESSION: All /construction tabs (Papan Mandor, Monitoring Unit, Antrean, Fase, QC, Laporan & Analitik, Template Jadwal) load without errors

success_percentage.frontend: 100% (13/13 user stories passed + regression tests passed)
